title: Pre-Commit Hook That Blocks Bad AI Commits (Husky)
description:
Stop your AI agent from committing broken code! 🚫

✅ Install husky and run husky init
✅ Put your check command in the pre-commit file
✅ A failing check now blocks the commit

Day 2 of Agent Harness. Next up: Day 3, Enforce Architecture with a Custom Lint.

comment: Husky or plain git hooks: which would you try first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep your pre-commit check fast, so it runs every time instead of getting skipped.
